detectors.description: Hardcoded API key detected
detectors.name: hardcoded_api_key
detectors.remediation: Move API keys to environment variables or a secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

detectors.description: Hardcoded password detected
detectors.name: hardcoded_password
detectors.remediation: Never embed passwords in source code. Use environment variables or a secrets manager.

detectors.description: Hardcoded authentication token detected
detectors.name: hardcoded_token
detectors.remediation: Store tokens in environment variables or a secrets manager. Rotate immediately if committed.

detectors.description: AWS access key ID detected
detectors.name: aws_access_key
detectors.remediation: Remove AWS credentials from source code. Use IAM roles, instance profiles, or AWS Secrets Manager.

detectors.description: Private key embedded in source code
detectors.name: private_key_block
detectors.remediation: Never embed private keys in source. Store in a secrets manager or use a key management service.

detectors.description: Hardcoded secret/credential detected
detectors.name: generic_secret
detectors.remediation: Move secrets to environment variables or a dedicated secrets manager.

detectors.description: Database connection string with embedded credentials
detectors.name: connection_string_password
detectors.remediation: Use environment variables for connection strings. Never embed credentials in URIs.

detectors.description: MD5 hash function -- cryptographically broken
detectors.name: md5_usage
detectors.remediation: Use SHA-256/SHA-3 for integrity checks, bcrypt/argon2 for passwords. MD5 is broken.

detectors.description: SHA-1 hash function -- weak for security purposes
detectors.name: sha1_password
detectors.remediation: Use SHA-256/SHA-3 for integrity, bcrypt/argon2/scrypt for passwords.

detectors.description: DES/3DES encryption -- deprecated and weak
detectors.name: des_usage
detectors.remediation: Use AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 for symmetric encryption.

detectors.description: ECB block cipher mode -- leaks data patterns
detectors.name: ecb_mode
detectors.remediation: Use GCM, CBC with HMAC, or CTR mode. Never use ECB for anything beyond single-block encryption.

detectors.description: Weak RSA key size (512/1024 bits)
detectors.name: weak_rsa_key
detectors.remediation: Use RSA-2048 minimum, RSA-4096 recommended. Consider switching to Ed25519.

detectors.description: Non-cryptographic random number generator used
detectors.name: random_not_secure
detectors.remediation: Use secrets module (Python) or crypto.getRandomValues() (JS) for security-sensitive randomness.

detectors.description: Debug mode enabled -- exposes internals in production
detectors.name: debug_mode
detectors.remediation: Set DEBUG=False in production. Use environment variables to control debug state.

detectors.description: CORS wildcard origin -- allows any domain to make requests
detectors.name: cors_wildcard
detectors.remediation: Restrict CORS origins to specific trusted domains. Never use '*' in production.

detectors.description: SQL query built with string formatting -- SQL injection risk
detectors.name: sql_format_string
detectors.remediation: Use parameterized queries (placeholders). Never interpolate user input into SQL strings.

detectors.description: SSL/TLS certificate verification disabled -- MITM attack risk
detectors.name: disable_ssl_verify
detectors.remediation: Always verify SSL certificates. Fix the root cause (expired cert, wrong CA) instead of disabling verification.

detectors.description: Hardcoded IP address -- may expose services unintentionally
detectors.name: hardcoded_ip
detectors.remediation: Use configuration files or environment variables for host bindings. Bind to 127.0.0.1 not 0.0.0.0 in dev.

detectors.description: Verbose error output -- may leak internal details to attackers
detectors.name: verbose_errors
detectors.remediation: Log full tracebacks server-side. Return generic error messages to clients.

detectors.description: CSRF protection disabled
detectors.name: no_csrf
detectors.remediation: Enable CSRF protection. Use framework-provided CSRF tokens for all state-changing requests.

detectors.description: Use of eval() -- arbitrary code execution risk
detectors.name: eval_usage
detectors.remediation: Replace eval() with ast.literal_eval() for data parsing, or use a safe expression evaluator.

detectors.description: Use of exec() -- arbitrary code execution risk
detectors.name: exec_usage
detectors.remediation: Avoid exec(). Use structured dispatch, importlib, or a sandbox if dynamic execution is required.

detectors.description: subprocess with shell=True -- command injection risk
detectors.name: subprocess_shell
detectors.remediation: Use shell=False (default) and pass arguments as a list. Sanitise all user input.

detectors.description: pickle deserialization -- arbitrary code execution via crafted payloads
detectors.name: pickle_loads
detectors.remediation: Use json, msgpack, or another safe serialization format. Never unpickle untrusted data.

detectors.description: Unsafe YAML loading -- arbitrary code execution risk
detectors.name: yaml_unsafe_load
detectors.remediation: Use yaml.safe_load() instead of yaml.load(). Never use yaml.UnsafeLoader.

detectors.description: marshal deserialization -- code execution risk from untrusted data
detectors.name: marshal_loads
detectors.remediation: Avoid deserializing untrusted data with marshal. Use JSON or another safe format.

detectors.description: os.system() -- command injection risk
detectors.name: os_system
detectors.remediation: Use subprocess.run() with shell=False and argument lists instead of os.system().

detectors.description: Insecure temporary file creation -- race condition risk
detectors.name: tempfile_insecure
detectors.remediation: Use tempfile.mkstemp() or tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() for secure temp file creation.

detectors.description: Security check using assert -- stripped in optimized mode (-O)
detectors.name: assert_security
detectors.remediation: Replace assert with explicit if/raise for security-critical checks. Assert is for debugging only.

detectors.description: Use of eval() -- arbitrary code execution risk
detectors.name: eval_usage
detectors.remediation: Use JSON.parse() for data, or a sandboxed evaluator. Never eval untrusted input.

detectors.description: Direct innerHTML assignment -- cross-site scripting (XSS) risk
detectors.name: innerhtml_xss
detectors.remediation: Use textContent for plain text, or sanitize with DOMPurify before setting innerHTML.

detectors.description: document.write() -- XSS risk and performance issues
detectors.name: document_write
detectors.remediation: Use DOM manipulation methods (createElement, appendChild) instead of document.write().

detectors.description: Command execution -- injection risk if input is unsanitized
detectors.name: child_process_exec
detectors.remediation: Use execFile() with argument arrays. Never interpolate user input into shell commands.

detectors.description: new Function() constructor -- equivalent to eval()
detectors.name: new_function
detectors.remediation: Avoid dynamic function creation. Use predefined functions or a safe dispatch pattern.

detectors.description: Potential prompt injection -- user input mixed into system prompt
detectors.name: prompt_injection_risk
detectors.remediation: Sanitize and validate all user input before including in prompts. Use structured prompt templates with clear boundaries.

detectors.description: Unrestricted tool access for agent -- excessive privilege
detectors.name: unrestricted_tool_access
detectors.remediation: Apply least-privilege: only expose the specific tools the agent needs. Use allowlists, not denylists.

detectors.description: Tool output used without validation -- injection via tool results
detectors.name: unvalidated_tool_output
detectors.remediation: Validate and sanitize all tool outputs before using them in prompts or executing them.

detectors.description: Unbounded or excessively large context window -- resource exhaustion risk
detectors.name: context_overflow
detectors.remediation: Set reasonable token limits. Implement input truncation and summarization for long contexts.

detectors.description: No output guardrails configured -- unfiltered agent output
detectors.name: no_output_filter
detectors.remediation: Implement output validation, content filtering, and safety guardrails for all agent responses.

detectors.description: LLM output passed directly to system command execution
detectors.name: raw_llm_to_system
detectors.remediation: Never execute LLM output as code or system commands. Use structured actions with validated parameters.

detectors.description: User input stored directly in agent memory -- memory poisoning risk
detectors.name: memory_poisoning_risk
detectors.remediation: Validate and sanitize user input before storing in agent memory. Implement memory integrity checks.
